facts.fact: The EAC Secretariat reports that the 3rd Project Steering Committee of the Eastern Africa Regional Digital Integration Project, held in Nairobi on 5-6 May 2026, brought together members from all eight EAC Partner States, Tanzania among them, who reaffirmed their commitment to regional digital integration.
